purpose: Implement the local first-run application profile front door beneath future UX: discover healthy durable Artist profiles without mutating unrelated services, create the first profile only on a truly empty healthy install, require explicit choice for multiple profiles, surface corrupt/malformed candidates as recovery issues, and serialize first creation so racing starts cannot silently fork Artist identity.

lineage.outcome: A fresh local N0TE install can establish exactly one durable Artist profile safely, while later launches discover/resume healthy profiles or require explicit selection/recovery instead of guessing or creating around corrupted state.
lineage.capability: Local profile discovery, first-profile bootstrap and explicit profile resolution

n0te2_dependencies: CORE-01 LineageStore and HeadquartersMemory profile identity
legacy_rejections: same-process concurrent creation treated as idempotent permission

completion_proof: empty healthy data root resolves NEEDS_CREATION until artist identity input is provided
first creation is serialized by an opaque bootstrap lease, re-discovers under ownership and creates exactly one Headquarters profile only if still empty
after creation the bootstrap lease is released and later resolve returns the same SELECTED_EXISTING profile
one healthy existing profile resolves deterministically; multiple healthy profiles return NEEDS_SELECTION until an exact existing profile is selected
invalid or unknown explicit selection is refused rather than guessed
valid-looking corrupt/malformed profile candidates yield RECOVERY_REQUIRED and prevent silent creation around them
profile-root or profile-candidate symlinks are recovery issues, including dangling root symlinks
catalog discovery uses LineageStore only and does not initialize unrelated Headquarters service schemas
non-profile noise is ignored and discovery never crawls outside data_root/profiles
same-process ALREADY_OWNED bootstrap state is BOOTSTRAP_BUSY rather than permission for a second concurrent create
foreign ALIVE bootstrap ownership is busy; UNKNOWN ownership fails closed; verified DEAD ownership may be replaced with previous-lease evidence
a profile appearing after initial discovery but before creation is observed by the under-lock recheck and prevents duplicate identity creation
ApplicationProfiles exposes only discover and resolve; no delete/merge/rename/account/cloud/sync behavior exists
next_selection_rule: After APP-01B evidence, audit remaining APP-01 obligations and globally compare the next real consumer lifecycle blocker against DAW-00, OPS-04 and any newly eligible work. Do not keep APP active merely because APP-01B is adjacent.
